body:
Kitchen Remodel Cost: The Real Numbers

A full kitchen remodel in NYC costs $28,000-$175,000. Median: $45,000-$85,000 for mid-sized kitchen with semi-custom cabinets and quartz countertops.

Cabinets: $8,000-$40,000 (largest line item). Countertops: $3,000-$15,000 (10-14 day fabrication after template). Plumbing: $3,000-$8,000 (DOB permitted). Electrical: $3,000-$8,000 (dedicated 20A circuits, EMT conduit). Backsplash: $1,500-$5,000. Flooring: $2,000-$6,000.

Timeline

5-10 weeks. Critical path: cabinet lead time, countertop fabrication, DOB inspections. Client selections due within 5 business days of signing.
